How to get it :
- Industrial anvil (construction) (x8) : [[RBMK Tungsten Carbide Neutron Reflector|RBMK Tungsten Carbide Neutron Reflector]].
- [[Arc Welder|Arc Welder]] (x2) : 2 x Tungsten Carbide Ingot, High-Speed Steel Plate.

Used to make :
[[gv:mp_warhead_10_nuclear_large|Size 10 Nuclear Warhead]], [[gv:mp_warhead_10_nuclear|Size 10 Micro Nuclear Warhead]], [[gv:mp_warhead_15_nuclear|Size 15 Nuclear Warhead]], [[gv:plate_mixed|Mixed Plate]], [[gv:pwr_reflector|PWR Neutron Reflector]], [[RBMK Tungsten Carbide Neutron Reflector|RBMK Tungsten Carbide Neutron Reflector]].
